# EBD Construction LLC

> Licensed and insured residential remodeler and general contractor in Gainesville, Georgia (Hall County). Owner Eric Bubniak and the same crew of three full-time builders remodel kitchens, bathrooms and whole homes, build additions, finish basements, build screened porches and decks, update siding and roofs, and build new custom homes across Hall County and Lake Lanier. Phone 404-925-7481. Free consultations.

## Key facts

- Business: EBD Construction LLC, residential remodeling contractor and home builder
- Owner: Eric Bubniak
- Based in: Gainesville, Georgia, USA (Hall County)
- Service area: Gainesville, Hall County, Flowery Branch, Oakwood, Chestnut Mountain, Buford, Braselton, Murrayville, Clermont, Lula, Gillsville, Cleveland, Dahlonega, Demorest, Cornelia and Lake Lanier
- Experience: 15+ years; the same three full-time builders have worked together for more than 10 years
- Licensed and insured; all work guaranteed; the owner pulls all building permits himself
- Reviews: 5-star reviews on Thumbtack (https://www.thumbtack.com/ga/gainesville/general-contractors/ebd-construction-llc/service/416170149124677645); references available on request
- Consultations are free and can include AI mockups of the homeowner's own space
- Phone: 404-925-7481 · Email: ericbubniak@gmail.com · Website: https://ebdconstructionllc.com/
